question: How much did Mindgard raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: British university spinoff Mindgard protects companies from AI threats | TechCrunch
hits.snippet: Since many of these prospective clients are U.S.-based, the company added some American flavor to its cap table. After raising a£3 million seed round in 2023, Mindgard is now announcing a new $8 million round led by Boston-based .406 Ventures, with participation from Atlantic Bridge, WillowTree Investments, and existing investors IQ Capital and Lakestar.

hits.title: Mindgard Raises $30M Series A - Mindgard
hits.snippet: BOSTON, Mass., Aug 12, 2026 – Mindgard, the leader in AI security, announced today that it has closed a $30 million Series A financing led by Album VC with participation from Karma Ventures and existing investors .406 Ventures, Atlantic Bridge, IQ Capital, and Lakestar. Mindgard plans to use the funding to scale the company across product, engineering, sales, and marketing in response to significant customer demand.

hits.title: Mindgard Raises $30 Million to Protect AI Systems - SecurityWeek
hits.snippet: AI security startup Mindgard today announced raising $30 million in a Series A funding round that brings the total raised by the company close to $42 million.

hits.title: Mindgard Raises $8M with Industry-First AI Security Solution - Mindgard
hits.snippet: In a significant milestone for AI security innovation, Mindgard is proud to announce its $8 million funding round led by .406 Ventures, alongside key strategic appointments of two industry leaders, Dave Ganly and Fergal Glynn. With this funding and expanded leadership, Mindgard is poised to transform the AI security landscape, addressing the critical risks associated with AI adoption. ... Today we announced an $8 million funding round and the appointment of two industry leaders to the roles of Head of Product and VP of Marketing. The funding was led by .406 Ventures with participation from Atlantic Bridge, Willowtree Investments and existing investors IQ Capital and Lakestar. The new executives, Dave Ganly, a former Director of Product at Twilio, and Fergal Glynn, who most recently served as CMO at Next DLP (acquired by Fortinet), will play a critical role in the company’s product development and launch Mindgard’s expansion into the North American market with a leadership presence in Boston.

hits.title: Lancaster University spinout Mindgard Ltd Raises £3M in Seed Funding  - Lancaster University
hits.snippet: Lancaster University spinout Mindgard Ltd Raises £3M in Seed Funding - Lancaster University ... A world-class technology spinout company from Lancaster University has secured £3M in seed funding to take the business to the next level. ... Mindgard, a startup specialising in security for AI, today announced that venture capital firms IQ Capital and Lakestar have invested as seed funders to bring Mindgard’s unique enterprise platform to market. ... The London-based firm which began as a spin out from Lancaster University - a UK top ten ranked university and established centre of excellence for cyber security teaching and research - intends to accelerate growth and expand operations with this £3M funding round.
